== Notes ==
* More effective in [[hard mode]], where foes have higher health and attack rate and will thus trigger it more often.
* This skill is highly potent against [[boss]]es, especially end-game bosses who have many times the health of a player character, assuming the boss attacks or casts targeted spells.
* Spoil Victor or alternatively [[Spiteful Spirit]] can be used for [[Soloing|solo]] [[farming]]. 
** Spoil Victor is especially effective for characters with low health, typically [[55hp]], as the character will almost always have low health and meet the requirement.
* This skill will trigger when a healer casts a [[heal]]ing spell on an [[ally]] with less health; however, self-targeting a healing spell will not cause health loss. [[Resurrection|Resurrecting]] an ally with a spell will also trigger Spoil Victor.

== Trivia ==
* This skill's name seems to be a pun on the saying "to the victor go the spoils", which is derived from the "to the victor belong the spoils", a quote from 19th century US Senator [[w:William L. Marcy|William L. Marcy]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|PvE]] and [[{{PAGENAME}} (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
